references.text: Ozias (Uzziah) is mentioned as king of Judah, who is the father of Jotham
Jotham, son of Uzziah, is mentioned as king of Judah
Ahaz, son of Jotham, is mentioned as king of Judah
Hezekiah, son of Ahaz, is mentioned as king of Judah
